name: Iri Vale
title: Relay quest contact
dialogue: Nella’s kitchen has no water, but the delivery records say it does. Talk to Oru first. Then read the shutoff notice at the Commons exchange and help turn the water back on.
afterKitchen: Nella has a relief shift now. I’m keeping a copy of the delivery record here. Your contact can help you follow the other entries; the routes are everyone’s concern.

name: Sera Quill
title: Glass Covenant quest contact
dialogue: Fourteen people missed a meal, but the records say they were fed. Talk to Oru, then read the kitchen shutoff notice at the Commons exchange. Help restore the water and save the notice as proof.
afterKitchen: Nella’s receipts are safe. I’ve kept the corrections beside the originals, so the next clerk can see why the total changed. Your contact is following another part of the same account.

name: Bram Cinder
title: Ash Foundry quest contact
dialogue: The kitchen pump works, but the billing system has locked it. Talk to Oru first, then read the job notice at the Commons exchange. Help restore the water and record the repair at the Public forge.
afterKitchen: Mina’s taking the kitchen shift. That matters as much as the pump. Bring your contact the work you find; I want the next repair sheet to name the people living with it.

name: Ves of the Quiet
title: Null Choir quest contact
dialogue: The kitchen’s water was cut off without a useful warning. Talk to Oru, read the notice at the Commons exchange, and help restore the water. Then record a warning at the Warning control panel.
afterKitchen: The kitchen has a warning people can use. Keep checking who receives the next one. Your faction’s work belongs beside ours in the Living Record.

name: Oru
title: Oru · character story quests
dialogue: I’m Oru. I keep people’s histories. Accept my welcome quest, then follow the marker to the Commons exchange. We’ll help reopen Nella’s kitchen and find the people who missed their meals.

name: Patch
title: Shopkeeper · supplies and upgrades
dialogue: I sell medkits and weapon upgrades. I can also make equipment, buy your spare items, and reset your talent points for gold. Take a repeatable job if you need more gold.

name: Mara Venn
title: Mourning Fen quest contact
dialogue: My father buys water from the same company that pays me to drain his well. Read the Fen water gauge. I need the numbers for tonight’s meeting.

name: Tovin Ash
title: Cinderwood quest contact
dialogue: The trees behind me are alive, but the company lists them as dead wood ready for cutting. Check the tree records before another crew arrives.

name: Ada Silt
title: Glassroot Steppe quest contact
dialogue: My partner’s ceramic body is cracked. The minerals under our well could make a new one. Read the soil survey before we decide whether it is safe to dig.

name: Ilex Marr
title: Brine Bloom quest contact
dialogue: Keep the jars shut. The fungi inside help our patients. The escaped fungus growing over the houses is dangerous. Help me check how far it has spread.

name: Nella Rook
title: Kitchen keeper · local quests
dialogue: Fourteen regular diners missed their meals yesterday. The records say I fed them all. Help bring the water back, then help me find out why they stopped coming.

name: Elin Voss
title: Glass Steps quest contact
dialogue: The expensive memory cabinets are cold, but patients’ memories are getting too warm. Help me find out why paying customers get cooling first.

name: Merek Tan
title: Copper Walk quest contact
dialogue: An empty office stays warm while twenty-three homes freeze. We can redirect the heat, but the paperwork would make our apprentice pay the old repair debts.

name: Sable Ren
title: Listening Courts quest contact
dialogue: We switched off the advertising speakers and lost our flood alarm too. Help me test a warning light and a vibrating handrail.

name: Ivo Pell
title: Last Connection quest contact
dialogue: Forty night workers used this lift, but the counter says nobody rode it. It ignores their service passes. Help me prove they need the route before it closes.
